zenstory-ai-novel-to-game-game-build.description: Build an approved game spec into a complete, runnable game using the rendering libraries, mini-game or TapTap Maker toolchains, modeling tools, and media generators available locally. Turns GAME_DESIGN and ART_DIRECTION into a playable graybox first, then the finished build with rule regressions, an end-to-end verify command, and BUILD_BRIEF. Use to implement an approved game spec, graybox core gameplay, or build a 2D, 2.5D, 3D, WeChat/Douyin mini-game, or TapTap Maker game. 游戏构建执行：调用本机可用的渲染库、微信/抖音小游戏或 TapTap 制造工具链及建模/生成工具（Three.js、UrhoX+Lua、Blender、图生 3D、2D 画布与音视频工具等），把已定稿的 GAME_DESIGN 与…

zenstory-ai-novel-to-game-game-design.description: Choose a playable gameplay concept, design world rules, systems, levels, and branching narrative, and set visual and audio direction. Turns SOURCE_BIBLE and PRODUCT_BRIEF into separate CONCEPT, GAME_DESIGN, and ART_DIRECTION specs stage by stage without writing code. Use when deciding what game a novel should become, comparing gameplay directions, writing a game design spec, designing branching story or interactive film scenes, or setting art direction. 游戏策划与美术方向：基于 SOURCE_BIBLE 与 PRODUCT_BRIEF 分阶段产出玩法选型（CONCEPT）、世界与叙事设计（GAME_DESIGN）及美术视听方案（ART_DIRECTION），覆盖改编方向比选、系统与关卡设计、互动叙事与影游分镜、视觉与音效定调。

zenstory-ai-novel-to-game-game-qa.description: Blind-playtest and verify a game on its target runtime as a first-time player without reading source code. Runs an isolated cold-start playthrough to catch onboarding, interaction, pacing, and mobile viewport issues, checks findings against the design specs, and writes a complete-run verification record. Use to blind-playtest a game build as a new player, audit first-run playability, or run end-to-end game QA. 游戏盲玩与通关验收：先以未读源码和策划案的新玩家身份从头盲玩，排查上手引导、交互卡点、视听穿帮与手机视口问题，再对照策划案区分缺陷与设计边界，并实跑生成单次完整通关的验收记录。

zenstory-ai-novel-to-game-novel-game-ana.description: Read and map a novel for game adaptation. Turn a raw novel, chapter breakdown, or writing project into a cited SOURCE_BIBLE covering main arcs, standout conflict scenes, character relationships and agendas, secrets and information gaps, world rules, signature spaces and props, and adaptation boundaries—without locking a genre early. Use for novel-to-game analysis, book breakdown for adaptation, or extracting story arcs, key scenes, characters, and world rules. 小说游戏化拆书：通读原始小说、拆文库或写作工程，整理出带原文出处的 SOURCE_BIBLE，理清全书主线、高光冲突桥段、人物关系与盘算、秘密与信息差、世界规矩、代表场景器物及改编红线，不提前锁死游戏品类。

zenstory-ai-novel-to-game-novel-to-game.description: Turn a novel in any language into a playable game for web, desktop, mobile, WeChat/Douyin mini-games, or TapTap Maker. Coordinates scope intake, full-book analysis, gameplay and art specs, local-tool builds, and blind-playtest QA. Use for novel-to-game, story-to-game, book-to-game, RPG, interactive story, text adventure, interactive film, WeChat/Douyin mini-game, or TapTap Maker requests. NovelToGame 总入口：把任意语言的小说、拆文库或写作工程做成忠于原著的可玩游戏，支持网页、桌面与移动端、微信/抖音小游戏及 TapTap 制造，串联需求确认、通读拆书、玩法与美术策划、用本机工具构建与新玩家盲玩验收。
